# Stratum

> Stratum (Stratum Technology) is a managed IT and cybersecurity company for growing businesses in the Lower Mainland, BC, Canada — headquartered in Abbotsford, serving the region since 2007. Structure, security, stability, simplicity, and stewardship: a structured, security-aware, dependable technology partner that acts as your designated IT department.

Stratum works with small and mid-sized organizations that have outgrown break-fix IT but don't need an in-house department — the "missing middle." Services span managed IT support, cybersecurity, business systems, and hardware lifecycle management.

Contact: hello@stratumtech.ca · 1 (855) 200-0076 · stratumtech.ca

## Facts

- Service area: Lower Mainland, BC — Abbotsford, Chilliwack, Langley, Surrey, Vancouver, and surrounding communities
- HQ: Abbotsford, British Columbia, Canada
- Operating since 2007 (as Stratum Systems; merged with Prism PC in 2012)
- Core services: managed IT support, cybersecurity, business systems, hardware procurement
- Formerly online at stratum.it; now at stratumtech.ca
